nodes.label: Part A - Structural (AST) Extraction
nodes.rationale: Deterministic, free, no LLM or API key needed.

nodes.label: Part B - Semantic Extraction (parallel subagents)
nodes.rationale: Only docs/papers/images go to semantic extraction; subagents must be general-purpose so they can write chunk files.

nodes.label: Semantic Extraction Cache (check/save_semantic_cache)
nodes.rationale: Cache entries are stamped with the prompt file (SPEC_PATH) that produced them (#1939).

nodes.label: Discrete Confidence Score Rubric
nodes.rationale: Models follow discrete rubrics better than continuous ranges; avoids collapse to 0.5 default.

nodes.label: Node ID Format Rule
nodes.rationale: IDs must match AST extractor output (full repo-relative path stem) to avoid ghost duplicate nodes.

nodes.label: Honesty Rules
nodes.rationale: Never invent an edge; show token cost and raw cohesion scores; warn before HTML viz of >5000 nodes.

nodes.label: No API Key Required Policy
nodes.rationale: Code is extracted via AST; semantic extraction uses Gemini only if a key is set, otherwise the host agent is the LLM.

nodes.label: graphify merge-graphs (cross-repo)
nodes.rationale: Running the skill per subfolder would clobber graphify-out/, so use CLI extract per subfolder then merge.

nodes.label: Step 1 - Ensure graphify Installed / Interpreter Detection
nodes.norm_label: step 1 - ensure graphify installed / interpreter detection
nodes.rationale: Interpreter path persisted to .graphify_python; scan root passed via quoted heredoc to prevent shell injection.

nodes.label: build_merge (replace-on-re-extract)
nodes.rationale: Reads graph.json directly without NetworkX round-trip so edge direction is preserved (#801); root= ensures pruning matches relative paths (#1361).

nodes.label: --watch Folder Watcher (graphify.watch)
nodes.rationale: Debounce (3s default) avoids rebuilding per file during parallel agent writes; docs only flag needs_update since they require LLM re-extraction.

nodes.label: Step 9 - Save Manifest and Cost Tracker
nodes.norm_label: step 9 - save manifest and cost tracker
nodes.rationale: Only semantic files that actually produced output are stamped, so failed chunks are re-queued on next --update (#2015).

nodes.label: source_file Verbatim Rule
nodes.rationale: Keeps full build and incremental --update on the same base so build_merge replaces rather than duplicates.

nodes.label: Shrink Guard (#479)
nodes.rationale: to_json refuses to write a graph smaller than the existing graph.json, preventing an empty extraction from clobbering a good graph.

nodes.label: Constrained Query Expansion
nodes.rationale: query CLI matches via case-folded substring + IDF without stemming/synonyms, so the question is expanded only with tokens from the graph vocabulary.

nodes.label: Fast Path: Existing Graph
nodes.rationale: If graph.json exists and the request is a question, skip rebuild and query directly.

nodes.label: Query Graph First Rule
nodes.rationale: graphify query/path/explain return a scoped subgraph, usually much smaller than GRAPH_REPORT.md or raw grep output.

nodes.label: Update Graph After Code Changes Rule
nodes.norm_label: update graph after code changes rule
nodes.rationale: graphify update . is AST-only with no API cost, so the graph can be kept current cheaply.

nodes.label: FalkorDB Export
nodes.rationale: FalkorDB GRAPH.QUERY runs one statement at a time, so --falkordb-push is preferred over the Cypher file.

nodes.label: Token Reduction Benchmark
nodes.rationale: Only run above 5000 words; small corpora value structure, not token compression.
